entries.s1_description: The response 454 (Session Not Found) MUST be returned if the session identifier is invalid.
entries.s2_description: The response 454 (Session Not Found) MUST be returned if the session identifier is invalid.

entries.llm_reason: Both statements describe the same server obligation to respond to a successful DESCRIBE request with a resource description.
entries.s1_description: The DESCRIBE reply-response pair constitutes the media initialization phase of RTSP. The server MUST respond with a description of the requested resource and return the description in the message body of the response, if the DESCRIBE method request can be successfully fulfilled.
entries.s2_description: The server MUST respond with a description of the requested resource and return the description in the message body of the response, if the DESCRIBE method request can be successfully fulfilled.

entries.llm_reason: Both describe the same client action of upgrading URI scheme from rtsp to rtsps; S1 includes additional MUST obligation for servers but shares the same core MAY permission.
entries.s1_description: A user or client MAY upgrade a non secured URI to a secured by changing the scheme from 'rtsp' to 'rtsps'. A server implementing support for 'rtsps' MUST allow this.
entries.s2_description: A user or client MAY upgrade a non secured URI to a secured by changing the scheme from "rtsp" to "rtsps".
